items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Johnny Hodges was known for this.

ctx.x: And he put a (inaudible) and take a rubber plunger and play nothing but straight melody. Wa-wa-wa-wa-wa-wa-wa-wa-wa-wa-wa, and make chills go up and down your spine, just no nothing but melody, just improvising. But

he had that much soul. He was a soulful man, and not too many people could take a melody other than a Johnny Hudges, and Johnny Hodges was known for this. And his tone, Fred Beckett was the same thing (inaudible).
